metadata.name: Aegis Agent Observability & Cost Centre Audit

display.name: Aegis Agent Observability & Cost Centre Audit
display.description: Production observability for Aegis multi-agent execution, 4-tuple attribution, Monty Rust sandbox metrics, and delegation latency.

display.name: Cost Centre ID
display.description: Filter telemetry by 4-tuple cost centre attribution

display.name: Agent ID
display.description: Filter telemetry by orchestrator agent identifier

display.name: Token Spend by Cost Centre
display.description: Total prompt and completion tokens attributed by 4-tuple cost_centre_id

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket(interval '1 minute', start_timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'cost_centre_id' AS cost_centre, sum(CAST(attributes->>'total_tokens' AS BIGINT)) AS tokens FROM records WHERE attributes->>'cost_centre_id' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time, cost_centre ORDER BY time

display.name: Cost Centre Chargeback Summary
display.description: Aggregated chargeback audit table by Actor and Cost Centre

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'cost_centre_id' AS cost_centre_id, attributes->>'actor_id' AS actor_id, count(*) AS total_runs, sum(CAST(coalesce(attributes->>'total_tokens', '0') AS BIGINT)) AS total_tokens, avg(duration) AS avg_duration_sec FROM records WHERE span_name = 'orchestrator.agent_run' GROUP BY cost_centre_id, actor_id ORDER BY total_tokens DESC LIMIT 50

display.name: Agent Execution Latency (P50 / P95 / P99)
display.description: Execution latency percentiles across orchestrator agent runs

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket(interval '1 minute', start_timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'agent_id' AS agent_id, avg(duration) AS avg_latency, max(duration) AS max_latency FROM records WHERE span_name = 'orchestrator.agent_run' GROUP BY time, agent_id ORDER BY time

display.name: Step Count Breakdown per Agent
display.description: Distribution of steps executed per agent session

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'agent_id' AS agent_id, avg(CAST(attributes->>'step_count' AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_steps, count(*) AS total_sessions FROM records WHERE span_name = 'orchestrator.agent_run' GROUP BY agent_id

display.name: Monty Rust Sandbox Executions (Success vs Failure)
display.description: Throughput and success/failure distribution of isolated Monty code mode sandbox runs

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket(interval '1 minute', start_timestamp) AS time, CASE WHEN is_exception THEN 'failure' ELSE 'success' END AS execution_status, count(*) AS execution_count FROM records WHERE span_name LIKE '%monty%' OR span_name LIKE '%sandbox%' GROUP BY time, execution_status ORDER BY time

display.name: Multi-Agent Delegation & Handoff Rates
display.description: Rate of supervisor-to-worker sub-agent delegations preserving 4-tuple composite identity

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket(interval '1 minute', start_timestamp) AS time, concat(attributes->>'caller_agent_id', ' -> ', attributes->>'target_agent_id') AS delegation_flow, count(*) AS handoffs FROM records WHERE span_name = 'orchestrator.handoff' GROUP BY time, delegation_flow ORDER BY time
